purpose: Independent service review for Bremen official cadastral and parcel-oriented map sources.
assessment: Bremen has an evidenced official local cadastral custodian and a public ALKIS WMS configured by the official Flurstücksviewer. Capabilities and CRS/schema were verified anonymously; the bounded exact-point feature-info response was empty, so no geometry sample is retained and runtime readiness remains held.
registryAssessment: The Landesamt GeoInformation Bremen publishes the Liegenschaftskataster/ALKIS, identifies the official GeoDatenService, and lists Bremen-wide open-data availability. This is cadastral/map evidence, not title or ownership evidence.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Bremen ALKIS WMS cadastral map, with official product documentation stating citywide availability.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Anonymous viewer configuration, capabilities, and one bounded GetFeatureInfo request; zero returned features.

attempts: Ran separate English and German first-party discovery queries.
Fetched the official Bremen Flurstücksviewer shell and current config.js/config.json anonymously.
Fetched the viewer's services.json and identified the ALKIS WMS endpoint, layer ALKIS, safe configured parcel fields, and EPSG:25832.
Fetched anonymous WMS 1.3.0 GetCapabilities and verified service title, ALKIS layer, parcel scope, and CRS.

Executed a bounded anonymous GetFeatureInfo request centered on the exact immutable WUP point; after supplying required FORMAT and STYLES parameters, the service returned an empty GML FeatureCollection.
Did not log in, use credentials or private tokens, defeat access controls, request owner/titleholder/personal/tax data, shift the WUP coordinate, or retain source-specific attributes.
